# AM-Lib OAM RTL provenance

The `L0` through `L3` source directories are an unmodified snapshot of the
OAM RTL from <https://github.com/skycrapers/AM-Lib/tree/main/OAM> at commit
`cc3864baead2584a94f0e7111e8d73d923fa3b35`.

The canonical local PPA campaign synthesizes each upstream `top` independently
under the same TSMC65, 10 ns, no-pipeline, explicit-flatten, area-optimization,
and vectorless PrimeTime policy used for the local OADM MUL-only wrappers.
